title: GLB Model A vs B PBR Parameter Diff Viewer
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) and GLTFLoader that implements a side-by-side PBR parameter diff viewer comparing two GLB models: VirtualCity.glb (Model A, left) and DragonDispersion.glb (Model B, right).

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a WebGLRenderer with toneMapping set to THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping, toneMappingExposure=1.0, outputColorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace.
- Create TWO viewports (left half and right half of the canvas) each with its own PerspectiveCamera (fov=45). Left camera looks at Model A, right camera looks at Model B. Both cameras start at distance 5 from origin along Z.
- Add an environment map using THREE.PMREMGenerator with a simple procedural equirectangular HDR (use THREE.HemisphereLight color=#ffffff groundColor=#444444 intensity=1.0 plus THREE.DirectionalLight position=(5,10,7) intensity=1.5 castShadow=true for both viewports).
- Load VirtualCity.glb and place it centered at (-3, 0, 0) for the left viewport. Load DragonDispersion.glb and place it centered at (3, 0, 0) for the right viewport. Auto-scale both models to fit within a 3-unit bounding sphere.
- Add a vertical divider line (DOM element, 2px wide, white) at the center of the screen.

PBR PARAMETER EXTRACTION:
- After loading each model, traverse all meshes and collect every MeshStandardMaterial or MeshPhysicalMaterial. For each material, extract: name, color (hex), roughness, metalness, emissive (hex), emissiveIntensity, opacity, transparent, alphaTest, side, map (boolean), normalMap (boolean), roughnessMap (boolean), metalnessMap (boolean), emissiveMap (boolean), aoMap (boolean), envMapIntensity.
- Store these in window.__3D_STATE__.modelA_materials (array of objects) and window.__3D_STATE__.modelB_materials (array of objects).

DIFF ENGINE:
- Compute a diff between Model A and Model B materials. For each parameter, compare across all materials. A parameter is 'different' if ANY material in A has a different value than the corresponding material in B (match by index, or by name if names match). Store diff results in window.__3D_STATE__.diffResults as an array of {paramName, modelA_value, modelB_value, isDifferent}.
- window.__3D_STATE__.diffCount should hold the total number of differing parameters.

INTERACTION MODES (cycled via keyboard 'M' key):
- Mode 0 'side_by_side': Default. Both models shown normally.
- Mode 1 'diff_highlight': Materials with differences are tinted red on both models. Non-differing materials are tinted green.
- Mode 2 'wireframe_overlay': Both models shown in wireframe mode to compare geometry complexity.
- Mode 3 'isolate_metalness': Both models rendered with a custom override where color = grayscale metalness value (black=0, white=1).
- Mode 4 'isolate_roughness': Both models rendered with color = grayscale roughness value.
- Store current mode in window.__3D_STATE__.currentMode (integer 0-4) and window.__3D_STATE__.modeName (string).

SYNC CONTROLS:
- Press 'L' to toggle camera lock/sync. When locked (window.__3D_STATE__.cameraSyncLocked = true), orbiting one viewport orbits both. When unlocked, each viewport orbits independently. Default: locked.
- Implement OrbitControls for each viewport. When locked, copy the spherical coordinates from the active viewport to the other.
- Store camera positions: window.__3D_STATE__.cameraA_position = {x,y,z}, window.__3D_STATE__.cameraB_position = {x,y,z}.

PARAMETER OVERRIDE PANEL (DOM):
- A collapsible panel on the right side (button with id='toggle-panel'). Panel id='param-panel'.
- Inside the panel: a dropdown (id='material-selector') listing all material names from Model A.
- Sliders: roughness (id='slider-roughness', 0-1, step 0.01), metalness (id='slider-metalness', 0-1, step 0.01), envMapIntensity (id='slider-envmap', 0-3, step 0.1).
- A checkbox (id='apply-to-both') to apply overrides to both models simultaneously.
- When a slider changes, update the selected material on Model A (and Model B if checkbox checked). Store overrides in window.__3D_STATE__.activeOverrides = {roughness, metalness, envMapIntensity}.
- An 'Undo' button (id='btn-undo') and 'Redo' button (id='btn-redo'). Maintain an undo stack (max 20 entries). window.__3D_STATE__.undoStackSize and window.__3D_STATE__.redoStackSize track counts.

SNAPSHOT & COMPARISON:
- Press 'S' to take a snapshot of current material states. Store in window.__3D_STATE__.snapshots (array, max 5). window.__3D_STATE__.snapshotCount tracks count.
- Press 'C' to compare current state against last snapshot. Store comparison result in window.__3D_STATE__.snapshotDiffCount (number of parameters changed since snapshot).

HUD:
- Top-left: 'Mode: <modeName>' (id='hud-mode').
- Top-center: 'Diff Count: <N>' (id='hud-diff-count').
- Top-right: 'Camera Sync: Locked/Unlocked' (id='hud-sync').
- Bottom-left: 'Materials A: <count> | Materials B: <count>' (id='hud-mat-count').
- Bottom-right: 'Snapshots: <count>/5 | Undo: <count> | Redo: <count>' (id='hud-history').

STATE OBJECT (window.__3D_STATE__):
{
  modelsLoaded: 0,  // increments as each model loads, should reach 2
  modelA_materials: [],
  modelB_materials: [],
  modelA_materialCount: 0,
  modelB_materialCount: 0,
  diffResults: [],
  diffCount: 0,
  currentMode: 0,
  modeName: 'side_by_side',
  cameraSyncLocked: true,
  cameraA_position: {x:0,y:0,z:5},
  cameraB_position: {x:0,y:0,z:5},
  activeOverrides: {roughness: null, metalness: null, envMapIntensity: null},
  undoStackSize: 0,
  redoStackSize: 0,
  snapshots: [],
  snapshotCount: 0,
  snapshotDiffCount: -1,
  panelOpen: false,
  applyToBoth: false,
  selectedMaterialIndex: 0
}

Ensure all state fields update in real-time as interactions occur. Use requestAnimationFrame for rendering both viewports each frame.
physics_constraints: No physics simulation. Material parameter values must remain in valid PBR ranges: roughness [0,1], metalness [0,1], envMapIntensity [0,3], opacity [0,1]. Undo/redo must perfectly restore previous parameter states with zero floating-point drift (store exact values, not deltas).
